The nebular theory of the formation of the solar system successfully predicts all but one
of the following. Which one does the theory not predict?

options.A: The presence of moons around several planets
options.B: Planets orbit around the Sun in nearly circular orbits in a flattened disk.
options.C: the equal number of terrestrial and jovian planets
options.D: The existence of the Sun's magnetic field
options.E: The different chemical compositions of the planets

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the equal number of terrestrial and jovian planets

questions.stem_text:
Under what conditions is the net electric flux through a closed surface proportional to
the enclosed charge?

options.A: only when there are no charges outside the surface
options.B: only when the charges are in motion
options.C: only when the electric field is uniform
options.D: only when the enclosed charge is negative
options.E: only when the charge is at rest

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - only when there are no charges outside the surface

questions.stem_text: Does an ideal gas get hotter or colder when it expands according to the law pV^2 = Const?

options.E: it gets colder, but only under low pressure

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - remains the same
